meta.title: Tab: every ride, who owes what
meta.description: A household ride tracker that converts every total to bolívares at the BCV rate. Try the demo.

hero.headline: Every ride, who owes what, in one place.
hero.before: Ride payments tracked from memory, in dollars, against a rate that changes daily.
hero.sub: Built for three people. Try it with sample data.
hero.alt: Tab's home screen: quick routes, the pending total in dollars and bolívares, and the rides waiting to be paid.

demo.note: Sample data, shared by every visitor. It resets every 4 hours.

features.title: The three things it does best

items.title: One tap per ride.
items.body: Usual routes are one tap away, and rides save even offline.
items.alt: The quick-ride card, ready to log a ride.

items.title: Dollars and bolívares.
items.body: Every total in USD and Bs, at the day's official BCV rate.
items.alt: The summary bar and a ride card, in USD and Bs.

items.title: Settle up.
items.body: Share a text summary of what's pending, then mark rides paid.
items.alt: The shared text summary of pending rides.

built.title: A small stack, in daily use

footer.privacy: No analytics. One cookie, for your language.
